g.text: 12 × MT6835 on SPI1 / SPI2 / SPI4 (4 per bus), every 1 ms
frame check: CRC-8, stuck bus, status bits
ω = 2π·Δcount / (2²¹·Δt), Δt from the CSN edges
= exact mean speed, stamped at the midpoint
→ per-rotor snapshot (loop switch with the 12-rotor mixer)
nav_dr: 21-state ESKF on the fused IMU
rotor thrust + drag model from the rotor speeds
ZUPT when the rotors are stopped
A: LG290P, USART3 NMEA · B: L76K, I2C1 raw NMEA
gnss_dual: pair by UTC tag (≤ 370 ms wait),
disagreement → no fix for that epoch
pages: power, RPM, diag, GNSS, GNSS_AUX,
values are MEASURED, never the commands sent
SPI5 shared with the UL radio and the FRAM

arming refused during a trial / with the IWDG
tcpip thread 40, eth_rx thread 44 (no frame loss),

priority inheritance; gnss holds it for one
SPI1 / SPI2 / SPI4: only task enc
TIM1 DMA: only the 1 kHz interrupt
no blocking I/O inside the interrupt
EXTI PE0: BNO08x INT → wakes task imu
EXTI PE10 / PF3: LR1121 DIO9 (UL / DL)
USART3 idle-line DMA: GNSS A sentences

input capture of the eRPM reply
TX PD8, RX PD9, RST PD12
SCK PE15, MISO PG1, MOSI PG2
open loop only without a feedback
each inner loop ≥ 3–5 × the outer one
baro 25 Hz · GNSS 1 Hz · RC 50 Hz
no HAL_Delay in the loop: TIM6 tick;
IMU time = INT edge + SH-2 delay
agent lost → same path, no special case
